summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new authentication methods: LinkedIn OAuth, Magic Link (passwordless), and Passkey (WebAuthn). All 16 backend tests passed. Frontend verification confirmed all 8 sign-in options on Login page and all 5 OAuth providers in Settings > Security.

LinkedIn_OAuth_Callback.details: POST /api/auth/linkedin/callback - Creates new user, updates existing user, sets linkedin_connected=true, returns valid JWT

Magic_Link_Send.details: POST /api/auth/magic-link/send - Creates user if not exists, generates token, returns _dev_token for testing

Magic_Link_Verify.details: POST /api/auth/magic-link/verify - Validates token, returns user and JWT, token is single-use

Passkey_Register_Options.details: POST /api/auth/passkey/register/options - Returns valid WebAuthn registration options with challenge, rp, user

Passkey_Authenticate_Options.details: POST /api/auth/passkey/authenticate/options - Returns WebAuthn auth options, supports discoverable credentials

Login_Page_All_Options.details: All 8 sign-in options visible: Email/Password, Google, Apple, Microsoft, Facebook, LinkedIn, Magic Link, Passkey

Magic_Link_UI_Flow.details: Magic Link button opens form, email input works, sends link, shows 'Check your email!' confirmation

Settings_Security_OAuth.details: All 5 OAuth providers shown in Connected Accounts: Google, Apple, Microsoft, Facebook, LinkedIn with Connect buttons

seed_data_creation: Test users created with TEST_ prefix during backend testing

login_page_buttons.magic_link: data-testid='magic-link-btn' - Opens form with data-testid='magic-link-email' and 'send-magic-link-btn'

notes.magic_link: Email may fail due to Resend test account limits but returns _dev_token for testing
notes.passkey: Uses webauthn library v2.7.0, requires browser WebAuthn support

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 authentication methods fully implemented and tested. LinkedIn OAuth follows same pattern as other OAuth providers. Magic Link creates token in DB and returns _dev_token for testing when email service is limited. Passkey endpoints return valid WebAuthn options. Previous OAuth tests in iteration_4.json still valid.
